name: k-flow-automation
description: K-Flow Automation - browser automation platform: form autofill, visual field mapping, macros, sandboxed JavaScript, variables, spreadsheets, text expansion, cloud sync and enterprise administration (Manifest V3).

scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs --unpacked && npm run package:source
scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@13.29.1 emulators:exec --only firestore --project k-flow-rules-test --config firebase/firebase.json "node --test tests/rules/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:cloud: npx -y firebase-tools@13.29.1 emulators:exec --only firestore --project k-flow-cloud-test --config firebase/firebase.json "npx vitest run -c vitest.cloud.config.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:cloud && npm run test:e2e
